changes: Changed the setting menu reset options to be more clear
Fixed the simulation settings tab breaking tabs following it
Fixed detecting keybind changes in the settings menu.
Fixed planets becoming shadowed when shadow setting is off
Fixed being able to select vehicle orbit lines while they are disabled
Removed temporary viewport toggle keybind as it conflicted with thruster translation controls.
Nearest orbit point now checks against the orbiting interface instead of separated between Celestial/Vehicle
added a pipeline debug name for compute shaders using the Brutal compute wrapper
Fixed some crashes before game start when minimizing/maximizing/resizing the game window.
Moved camera view settings from the orbit controller on to each Astronomical, meaning the view state will be remembered for an object even if you switch away and come back later.
Fixes for window content scaling after the last Brutal update
Changed all Math.Acos to use MAthEx.SafeAcos in all orbit, patched conics and orbital transfer calcs.
Changed SoundReference type to inherit from FileReference. This brings its loading behaviour to parity with other asset types.
Updated the arrow gizmo to a higher poly mesh
Fixed the thrust editor position box being incredibly small. It is now 'normal'.
the sunset finale has now been clamped to a minimum (from Earth's perspective) [WIP] for other planets
TODO: clean up some infrastructure based on finale transmittance approach we select
small change to visibility of eclipsed flares making eclipsing harder in certain situations
Fixed a crash if the orbit camera is used but no object is followed.
Fixed overbloom in vessel materials. Possibly be replaced later when we fix PBR in general, but for now works fine.
Next stage of multi-window rendering
Progress towards having a simplified "map view" rendering to the secondary window
ConsoleWindow now moves to the focused window and executes commands on the viewport/camera associated with that window
Terminology changes to make it more obvious which camera is "active" or "hovered"
Added Sounds can now be authored in an AssetBundle
Changed moved button sound to DefaultAssets.xml
Added SoundEvent data class for linking state behaviours to sound triggers
Fixed incorrect filepath formatting on button audio
Changed Velocity gauge to use a decimal label, rather than color, for decimal values.
Fixed bug with SDF rendering of non-standard colors, where AA would break and be misapplied, resulting in a blurry special character.
Removed log spam for shader lighting.
Missed some of the MathEx.Acos changes from the previous commit.
Changed the Orbit line alpha fade so that it starts at 1 opacity at the current object position (updating continuously), whereas before it was starting 1 opacity at the Pe.
Added a Delete button into the navball HUD that deletes the current maneuver.

Changed the maneuver node to change the rate of change based on the distance of the mouse from the gizmo as well as the distance of the camera from the gizmo to help make maneuver rate of change more intuitive
Added decimal place indicators to attitude rate rollers on navball, to increase clarity of what units were decimal places.
added separate bloom pass to allow for global and thresholded passes together
bloom passes now have weighted average options (beyond just blur scaling)
added separate debug menus and names for bloom options
typo fix in shader references - It is now appropriately Vertical.

Fixed digit roller animation was to nearest, not directional. This fixes a number of digit roller problems. Still remains an issue of transit in one direction, likely needs the overall direction to be sent in instanced buffer, but this will requires a small refactor to the buffer prep.
Added barber pole indicator on disabled buttons instead of the red LED.
blackrack's pass on sampling the sun for transmittance color
unifies color to GPU side calculations for atmosphere/sun
this commit cleans up some of the other transmittance options and orphaned comments
this currently shadows the adapative scalar in sol debug, but with changes made a few commits back, we aren't using it and it can be safely
Fixed navball buttons were always pressed visually with last commit.
changed vel/s to dst/s in one of the gauge labels - Note: Gauge data currently reads as km
Added Texture Tiling parameter for controlling each biome material's tiling on the planet.
Added Height Tiling parameter for controlling each biome's detail heightmap texture tiling on the planet.
Added Height Deformity parameter for controlling each biome's detail heightmap deformity on the planet.
Fixed crash around planets without a TerrainReference.
Fixed biome sampling in the planet tessellation shader using the wrong normal.
Fixed terrain depth pass
Changed Sound files are now loaded from memory rather than by passing the path directly to fmod. This is in preparation for when mod libraries move to compressed format.
Fixed maneuver nodes disappearing when too far away from the camera.
